verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל תֹּאמַר֒ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֣ר׀ הַגָּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִזַּרְע֛וֹ לַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת עַ֥ם הָאָ֖רֶץ יִרְגְּמֻ֥הוּ בָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- bə·nê yiś·rå̄·ʾēl tō·mar ’îš ’îš mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·min- hag·gêr hag·gār bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yit·tên miz·zar·‘ōw lam·mō·leḵ mō·wṯ yū·māṯ ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ yir·gə·mu·hū ḇā·’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites . . . Any . . . Israelite . . . or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death . . . The people of the land are to stone him
verses.literalPt: Também dirás aos filhos de Israel: Qualquer dos filhos de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinarem em Israel, que der de seus filhos a Moloque certamente será morto; o povo da terra o apedrejará.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ נָתַ֣ן לַמֹּ֔לֶךְ לְמַ֗עַן טַמֵּא֙ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּלְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’et·tên ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·’îš ha·hū wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’ō·ṯōw miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mōw kî miz·zar·‘ōw nā·ṯan lam·mō·leḵ lə·ma·‘an ṭam·mê ’eṯ- miq·dā·šî ū·lə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî
verses.literal: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people because by giving his offspring to Molech . . . he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name
verses.literalPt: Eu porei o meu rosto contra esse homem, e o cortarei dentre o seu povo; porque deu de seus filhos a Moloque, para contaminar o meu santuário e para profanar o meu santo nome.

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ מִן־ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא בְּתִתּ֥וֹ מִזַּרְע֖וֹ לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הָמִ֥ית אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ha‘·lêm ya‘·lî·mū ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê·hem min- hā·’îš ha·hū bə·ṯit·tōw miz·zar·‘ōw lam·mō·leḵ lə·ḇil·tî hā·mîṯ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And if the people of the land ever hide . . . their eyes and fail to put to death - the man who gives one of his children to Molech
verses.literalPt: Se o povo da terra fechar os olhos para não ver esse homem, quando der de seus filhos a Moloque, e não o fizer morrer,

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־ פָּנַ֛י בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜וֹ וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ הַזֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗יו לִזְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ’ă·nî ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·’îš ha·hū ū·ḇə·miš·paḥ·tōw wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’ō·ṯōw wə·’êṯ kāl- haz·zō·nîm ’a·ḥă·rāw liz·nō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ham·mō·leḵ miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mām
verses.literal: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off - from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves . . . with Molech
verses.literalPt: eu porei o meu rosto contra esse homem e contra a sua família, do seu povo o cortarei a ele e a todos os que após ele idolatrarem a Moloque.

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפְנֶ֤ה אֶל־ הָֽאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים לִזְנ֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בַּנֶּ֣פֶשׁ הַהִ֔וא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer tip̄·neh ’el- hā·’ō·ḇōṯ wə·’el- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nîm liz·nō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- pā·nay ban·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’ō·ṯōw miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Whoever turns to mediums . . . or spiritists to prostitute himself with them I will also set My face against that person . . . and cut him off from his people
verses.literalPt: O homem que se voltar para os necromantes e os feiticeiros, para idolatrar com eles, contra esse homem porei o meu rosto e o cortarei dentre o seu povo.

verses.original: וְהִ֨תְקַדִּשְׁתֶּ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֑ים כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·qad·diš·tem wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy because I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Santificai-vos e sede santos; pois eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them I am the LORD who sanctifies you
verses.literalPt: Guardareis os meus estatutos, e os cumprireis: eu sou Jeová, que vos santifico.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת־ אָבִ֛יו וְאֶת־ אִמּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת אָבִ֧יו וְאִמּ֛וֹ קִלֵּ֖ל דָּמָ֥יו בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’îš ’îš ’ă·šer yə·qal·lêl ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- ’im·mōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw qil·lêl dā·māw bōw
verses.literal: If anyone . . . curses his father or mother he must be put to death . . . He has cursed his father or mother his blood shall be upon him
verses.literalPt: Quem amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe certamente será morto. Amaldiçoou a seu pai ou a sua mãe; o seu sangue recairá sobre ele.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנְאַף֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנְאַ֖ף אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ מֽוֹת־ יוּמַ֥ת הַנֹּאֵ֖ף וְהַנֹּאָֽפֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yin·’ap̄ ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ ’îš ’ă·šer yin·’ap̄ ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū mō·wṯ- yū·maṯ han·nō·’êp̄ wə·han·nō·’ā·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife - with the wife of his neighbor both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Se um homem cometer adultério com mulher casada, isto é, se cometer adultério com a mulher do seu próximo, certamente serão mortos o adúltero e a adúltera.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יו גִּלָּ֑ה מֽוֹת־ יוּמְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḇîw ‘er·waṯ ’ā·ḇîw gil·lāh mō·wṯ- yū·mə·ṯū šə·nê·hem də·mê·hem bām
verses.literal: If a man lies with his father’s wife he has uncovered his father’s nakedness Both must surely be put to death . . . their blood is upon them
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se deitar com a mulher de seu pai, terá descoberto a nudez de seu pai; ambos certamente serão mortos; o seu sangue recairá sobre eles.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ כַּלָּת֔וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמְת֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם תֶּ֥בֶל עָשׂ֖וּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- kal·lā·ṯōw mō·wṯ yū·mə·ṯū šə·nê·hem te·ḇel ‘ā·śū də·mê·hem bām
verses.literal: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law both must surely be put to death . . . They have acted perversely their blood is upon them
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se deitar com a sua nora, ambos certamente serão mortos; cometeram uma confusão; o seu sangue recairá sobre eles.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת־ זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- zā·ḵār miš·kə·ḇê ’iš·šāh tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ‘ā·śū šə·nê·hem mō·wṯ yū·mā·ṯū də·mê·hem bām
verses.literal: If a man lies with a man . . . as with a woman they have both committed an abomination They must surely be put to death . . . their blood is upon them
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se deitar com outro homem, como se faz com uma mulher, ambos terão praticado uma abominação; certamente serão mortos, e o seu sangue recairá sobre eles.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֛ה וְאֶת־ אִמָּ֖הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֞שׁ יִשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶתְהֶ֔ן וְלֹא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה זִמָּ֖ה בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’iš·šāh wə·’eṯ- ’im·māh zim·māh hî bā·’êš yiś·rə·p̄ū ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ·hen wə·lō- ṯih·yeh zim·māh bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem
verses.literal: If a man marries both a woman and her mother it is depraved Both he and they must be burned in the fire so that there will be no depravity among you
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tomar uma mulher e a mãe dela, maldade é: serão queimados com o fogo, tanto ele como elas, para que não haja maldade no meio de vós.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכָבְתּ֛וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yit·tên šə·ḵā·ḇə·tōw biḇ·hê·māh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·hê·māh ta·hă·rō·ḡū
verses.literal: If a man lies carnally with an animal he must be put to death . . . And you are also to kill the animal
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se ajuntar com um animal, certamente será morto; também matareis o animal.

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל־ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָה֙ לְרִבְעָ֣ה אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָרַגְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer tiq·raḇ ’el- kāl- bə·hê·māh lə·riḇ·‘āh ’ō·ṯāh wə·hā·raḡ·tā ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·hê·māh mō·wṯ yū·mā·ṯū də·mê·hem bām
verses.literal: If a woman approaches . . . any animal to mate with it you must kill both the woman and the animal They must surely be put to death . . . their blood is upon them
verses.literalPt: Se uma mulher se chegar a um animal e se ajuntar com ele, matarás a mulher e bem assim o animal; certamente serão mortos, e o seu sangue recairá sobre eles.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִקַּ֣ח אֶת־ אֲחֹת֡וֹ בַּת־ אָבִ֣יו א֣וֹ בַת־ אִ֠מּוֹ וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָ֜הּ וְהִֽיא־ תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתוֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא וְנִ֨כְרְת֔וּ לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמָּ֑ם עֶרְוַ֧ת אֲחֹת֛וֹ גִּלָּ֖ה עֲוֺנ֥וֹ יִשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer- yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw baṯ- ’ā·ḇîw ’ōw ḇaṯ- ’im·mōw wə·rā·’āh ’eṯ- ‘er·wā·ṯāh wə·hî- ṯir·’eh ’eṯ- ‘er·wā·ṯōw ḥe·seḏ hū wə·niḵ·rə·ṯū lə·‘ê·nê bə·nê ‘am·mām ‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw gil·lāh ‘ă·wō·nōw yiś·śā
verses.literal: If a man marries his sister whether the daughter of his father or of his mother and they have sexual relations . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . it is a disgrace They must be cut off in the sight of their people He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister he shall bear his iniquity
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tomar sua irmã, por parte de pai ou por parte de mãe, e vir a nudez dela, e ela vir a nudez dele, é uma coisa vergonhosa. Serão exterminados à vista dos filhos do seu povo; descobriu a nudez de sua irmã; ele levará sobre si a sua iniquidade.

verses.original: וְ֠אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְגִלָּ֤ה אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָהּ֙ אֶת־ מְקֹרָ֣הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה וְהִ֕יא גִּלְּתָ֖ה אֶת־ מְק֣וֹר דָּמֶ֑יהָ וְנִכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer- yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ’iš·šāh dā·wāh wə·ḡil·lāh ’eṯ- ‘er·wā·ṯāh ’eṯ- mə·qō·rāh he·‘ĕ·rāh wə·hî gil·lə·ṯāh ’eṯ- mə·qō·wr dā·me·hā wə·niḵ·rə·ṯū šə·nê·hem miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mām
verses.literal: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her - he has exposed the source of her flow and she has uncovered the source of her blood Both of them must be cut off from among their people
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se deitar com uma mulher no tempo da enfermidade dela e descobrir a sua nudez, ele desnudou a fonte dela, e ela descobriu a fonte de seu sangue: ambos serão exterminados dentre o seu povo.

verses.original: וְעֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּךָ֛ וַאֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּ֧י אֶת־ שְׁאֵר֛וֹ הֶעֱרָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘er·waṯ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’im·mə·ḵā wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lō ṯə·ḡal·lêh kî ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rōw he·‘ĕ·rāh ‘ă·wō·nām yiś·śā·’ū
verses.literal: You must not have sexual relations with . . . the sister of your mother or your father for it is exposing one’s own kin both shall bear their iniquity
verses.literalPt: Não descobrirás a nudez da irmã de tua mãe, nem da irmã de teu pai; porque isso será descobrir a nudez de tua parenta chegada: levarão sobre si a sua iniquidade.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ דֹּ֣דָת֔וֹ עֶרְוַ֥ת דֹּד֖וֹ גִּלָּ֑ה חֶטְאָ֥ם יִשָּׂ֖אוּ עֲרִירִ֥ים יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- dō·ḏā·ṯōw ‘er·waṯ dō·ḏōw gil·lāh ḥeṭ·’ām yiś·śā·’ū ‘ă·rî·rîm yā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle They will bear their sin they shall die childless
verses.literalPt: Se um homem se deitar com a mulher de seu tio, descobriu a nudez de seu tio; levarão sobre si o seu pecado; morrerão sem filhos.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת־ אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֛יו גִּלָּ֖ה עֲרִירִ֥ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḥîw nid·dāh hî ‘er·waṯ ’ā·ḥîw gil·lāh ‘ă·rî·rîm yih·yū
verses.literal: If a man marries his brother’s wife it is an act of impurity He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother they shall be childless
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tomar a mulher de seu irmão, é uma impureza; descobriu a nudez de seu irmão; eles não terão filhos.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ תָקִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּה לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- kāl- miš·pā·ṭay wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- ṯā·qî ’eṯ·ḵem hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem šām·māh lā·še·ḇeṯ bāh
verses.literal: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances - so that the land where I am bringing - you to live will not vomit you out
verses.literalPt: Guardareis todos os meus estatutos e todos os meus juízos e os cumprireis, para que não vos vomite a terra na qual vos hei de introduzir para nela morardes.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקֹּ֣ת הַגּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשׂ֔וּ וָאָקֻ֖ץ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯê·lə·ḵū bə·ḥuq·qōṯ hag·gō·w ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî mə·šal·lê·aḥ mip·pə·nê·ḵem kî ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh ‘ā·śū wā·’ā·quṣ bām
verses.literal: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you Because they did all these things I abhorred them
verses.literalPt: Não andareis nos costumes da nação que eu hei de expulsar de diante de vós, porque fizeram todas estas coisas e, por isso, os aborreci.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר לָכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אַדְמָתָם֒ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לָכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־ הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lā·ḵem ’at·tem tî·rə·šū ’eṯ- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wa·’ă·nî ’et·tə·nen·nāh lā·ḵem lā·re·šeṯ ’ō·ṯāh ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer- hiḇ·dal·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: But I have told you that you will inherit their land since I will give it to you as an inheritance a land flowing with milk and honey I am the LORD your God who has set you apart from the peoples
verses.literalPt: Mas a vós vos tenho dito: Herdareis a sua terra, e eu vo-la darei para a possuirdes, uma terra que mana leite e mel. Eu sou Jeová, que vos separei dos povos.

verses.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין־ הַבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּהֹרָה֙ לַטְּמֵאָ֔ה וּבֵין־ הָע֥וֹף הַטָּמֵ֖א לַטָּהֹ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָכֶ֖ם לְטַמֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḇ·dal·tem bên- hab·bə·hê·māh haṭ·ṭə·hō·rāh laṭ·ṭə·mê·’āh ū·ḇên- hā·‘ō·wp̄ haṭ·ṭā·mê laṭ·ṭā·hōr wə·lō- ṯə·šaq·qə·ṣū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bab·bə·hê·māh ū·ḇā·‘ō·wp̄ ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tir·mōś hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- hiḇ·dal·tî lā·ḵem lə·ṭam·mê
verses.literal: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds Do not become contaminated - by any animal or bird or by anything that crawls on the ground I have set these apart as unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Fareis separação entre os animais limpos e imundos; e não fareis as vossas almas abomináveis por causa de animais, ou de aves, ou de tudo de que está cheia a terra, as quais coisas apartei de vós como imundas.

verses.original: וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָאַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִן־ הָֽעַמִּ֖ים לִהְי֥וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wih·yî·ṯem lî qə·ḏō·šîm kî qā·ḏō·wōš ’ă·nî Yah·weh wā·’aḇ·dil ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·‘am·mîm lih·yō·wṯ lî
verses.literal: You are to be holy to Me because I the LORD am holy and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own
verses.literalPt: Sereis para mim santos, porque eu, Jeová, sou santo e vos separei dos povos, para serdes meus.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּאֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ōw- ’iš·šāh kî- yih·yeh ḇā·hem ’ō·wḇ ’ōw yid·də·‘ō·nî mō·wṯ yū·mā·ṯū bā·’e·ḇen yir·gə·mū ’ō·ṯām də·mê·hem bām
verses.literal: A man or a woman . . . who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death . . . They shall be stoned their blood is upon them
verses.literalPt: O homem (ou mulher) que for necromante ou feiticeiro certamente será morto; apedrejá-lo-ão, o seu sangue recairá sobre eles.
